---
title: "Overview"
---

`omero-utils` is the layer every other OMERO-Screen package uses to talk to an
OMERO server. It is deliberately small: connection lifecycle, attachments, map
annotations, image I/O and plate iteration, with no analysis logic.

## The connection decorator

Connections are managed by a decorator rather than by hand, so a function
never has to open, check or close a session itself.

```python
from omero_utils.omero_connect import omero_connect
from omero.gateway import BlitzGateway


@omero_connect
def count_wells(plate_id: int, conn: BlitzGateway | None = None) -> int:
    assert conn is not None
    plate = conn.getObject("Plate", plate_id)
    return len(list(plate.listChildren()))


count_wells(1234)   # the connection is opened, injected, and closed for you
```

Credentials come from the environment (`USERNAME`, `PASSWORD`, `HOST`), loaded
from the `.env.{ENV}` file — see
[Install & configure](../../user-guide/installation.html).

If the server cannot be reached the decorator raises `OmeroConnectionError`
rather than returning a half-open session.
